messages:
Kelly (support): Customer ZetaCorp reporting p99 spike on streaming endpoint since 03/12, says TTFB looks fine but total time often 3-6s higher than expected, attached request_id=rc-98321 and sample curl. They see H2 only, SSE disabled. Can we triage?
Maya - Eng Runtime: thanks — do we have a quick repro? stream vs non-stream comparison will help. suspecting chunk flush/coalescing at our proxy or origin side. :mag:
Kelly (support): repro attached in thread, small payload, streaming=true returns first chunk ~80ms then long silence, non-stream returns ~1.2s total which used to be ~400ms. customer says regression started after last runtime rollout.
Samir P: timeline makes sense. ask customer to run both variants with -H 'Connection: keep-alive' and -v so we can see headers. also need flowtrace ID from our header x-rw-trace for the failing requests.
Tiago - Oncall: adding live-traces now. Maya, can you check if chunk-interval config was changed in rollout (flush-window, immediate-first-chunk)? also check kernel selection changes that might affect token batching.
Maya - Eng Runtime: scanning deploys — there was a change to the proxy coalescing patch (coalesce window default 6ms -> 10ms) and a fallback in h2 path that can hold tiny chunks to assemble. That would explain longer tail for multi-chunk responses.
latency-bot: observed metrics for rc-98321: p95_streaming_total=1.9s -> 2.8s post-rollout, p99_streaming_total=2.6s -> 5.9s, p95_TTFB unchanged (~120ms).
Kelly (support): customer really needs a mitigation today — can we offer them a config toggle? they are on Dedicated plan.
Samir P: we can flip their tenant to force non-streaming or set proxy.coalesce_ms=0 for that tenant to restore prior behavior. quick mitigation: tenant flag "force_no_coalesce". downside: may increase small-request QPS.
Maya - Eng Runtime: agree. also propose a temporary canary rollback of the coalesce increase for h2 path while we investigate batching heuristics. But per-tenant toggle is fastest.
Tiago - Oncall: I can apply force_no_coalesce to ZetaCorp tenant, will monitor p99. Doing it now.
latency-bot: applied toggle for tenant zeta_corp. new metrics streaming_total p95=1.1s, p99=1.5s (5 min post-change).
Kelly (support): relaying to customer: they confirmed immediate improvement and reduced error rate. They're asking for permanent fix and why the rollout increased coalescing.
Maya - Eng Runtime: root cause likely guardrail change to coalescing to reduce tiny-payload overhead at scale. It interacted poorly with H2 flow-control where immediate-first-chunk was expected by some SDKs. Plan: revert h2 coalesce delta and add an opt-in cost-based coalescing rather than global. Also add telemetry to track first-chunk gap distribution by protocol.
Samir P: action items: 1) keep tenant toggle for zeta until rollback & fix (owner Tiago), 2) rollback coalesce delta on h2 canary (owner Maya), 3) add per-proto first-chunk gap histogram (owner Samir). ETA for rollback?
Maya - Eng Runtime: rolling back canary in next 30m, will post status.
Tiago - Oncall: leaving tenant toggle in place until rollback validated, will notify support when safe to remove.
Kelly (support): thanks team — I'll update the customer and close the escalation once you confirm rollback. :thumbsup:
